comment: Current per-constant grades (v4). Regrade rule, stated once: the branch-equality theorem (m_b(N)N^{b+1} is a single polynomial for every N>=1; TU lattice-polytope representation + Ehrhart) and the parity theorem close the Toeplitz-trace route, so each m_b below is a PROVED exact rational determined by the archived finite-N tables (all with fit surplus >= 1 after the odd-b extension points) plus the model-transfer lemma.  The tags inside the frozen m_tables.json / m_tables_ext.json are their freeze-time snapshots and are intentionally not edited.  Former closure items (C_9 facet, F-IMPL-13/14, Sigma_10/12 joint layers) are redundancy; delivered ones are noted.

redundancy_delivered.{7,2} inventory: archived (constants/j72, g_be BE7).  NOTE: this is inventory only -- {7,2} is SINGLE-PATH.  See redundancy_open_optional and AUDIT_R177 2.5.
redundancy_delivered.m9(8) dual implementation: HIT BITWISE (AUDIT_R177 / order O-R176-2).  The math-side reference engine p3_direct_sum.m_b(9,8) -- direct lattice summation over 15^8 = 2,562,890,625 points, exact Fraction throughout -- returned 2365045367/33554432, bitwise equal to the archived compute-side (span-DP) value in m_tables_ext.json.  2040 s single core, peak RSS 83 MB, character cache 316,995 entries.  Gate F-BE-EXT-9's 'dual impl pending addendum' is discharged.

redundancy_open_optional: dual implementation of m11(9): FEASIBLE, costed (AUDIT_R177 O-R176-2). 17^10 = 2.016e12 lattice points; measured throughput 0.9-1.1e6 points/s gives ~18-22 days single core, ~13 h on 40 workers, ~6.6 h on 80. PREREQUISITE: p3_direct_sum's character/trace_moment caches are now bounded (AUDIT_R177), but the cap must be sized by a 1/64 probe shard before committing workers -- at m11(9) the UNBOUNDED caches reached 1.63e6 entries / 435 MB after 13 of 83,521 shards and were still growing (upper bound on distinct (mu,nu) pairs: 252,116). Size jobs by memo x worker, not by core count (r136 incident 3bis).

dual implementation of m13(10): NOT FEASIBLE, costed (AUDIT_R177). 19^12 = 2.213e15 lattice points; at the same measured throughput that is ~66 years single core, ~604 days on 40 workers, ~302 days on 80. This independently confirms the existing downgrade recorded in ADJUDICATION_R160_BE6.md sec 6.

facet second paths for {2,2,5}, {5,4}, {6,2,2} AND {7,2} (all single-path; values consumed via the proved route). {7,2} was added to this list by AUDIT_R177 2.5: its former 'pre-registered-identity' label rested on C_9 + {7,2} = -75863/302400, an identity already spent certifying C_9; one equation cannot independently confirm both of its own terms. RECEIPT_R148_J72.md sec 3 recorded this correctly from the start.
audit_note_r177: AUDIT_R177: m9(8) dual implementation delivered (see redundancy_delivered); m11(9) costed and feasible; m13(10) costed and confirmed infeasible; {7,2} regraded to single-path.  No m_b VALUE changed in this audit.
